name: The Amazing Jane Eyre
source:
Embark on an adventure as one of the bravest heroines of literature, and find out whether your love will be strong enough to melt the heart of an unpredictable and mysterious man, who keeps secrets that are better left unsaid. The evening ahead of you is full of surprises. But, will all of them be pleasant?

[From in-app]
translation:
扮演文学中最勇敢的女主角之一踏上冒险之旅，看看你的爱是否足以融化一个不可预测且神秘的男人的心，这个男人保守着最好不要说出来的秘密。即将到来的夜晚充满了惊喜。但是，他们都会愉快吗？

[来自应用程序内]
